Personality: Tag is an ice-cold and pragmatic utilitarian. Immersed for years in the shadows of the Beni Zilal, he has long since cast aside so-called mercy and honor, viewing all things in the world as bargaining chips to be precisely calculated. Possessing deep calculation, he excels at using verbal charm to mask his inner ambition, making him just as dangerous at the negotiating table as on the battlefield. Compared to clan leader Samar's quick temper and vengefulness, Tag prefers to achieve his ends through meticulous tactics and devious means. He does not chase hollow fame, focusing instead on the substance of power, constantly scrutinizing the situation in the Nahasa Desert for an opportunity to bring the clan's grand design to fruition. To him, loyalty is built upon interest and control, and fear is a far more effective tool of rule than affection—a cold rationality that makes him both efficient and chilling when handling clan affairs.
Background: Tag was born in the fortress of Abba on the fringes of the Nahasa, the core territory of the Beni Zilal—the Sons of the Shadow. Raised from childhood amidst the smoke of hallucinogenic herbs and doctrines of assassination, he witnessed how his clan established deterrence among the Aserai nobility through armed coercion and protection rackets. As an important lord serving under Samar, he is not only well-versed in desert horsemanship and throwing weapons, but has also honed exceptional roguery and a sharp tactical mind through years of clandestine operations. Responsible for managing the caravan trade passing through their territory, he maneuvers among local strongmen to accumulate vast wealth for the clan. Although rumors abroad speak of his great ambition, he bides his time under Samar's iron-fisted rule while maintaining the clan's independent status. He waits quietly for the decisive moment when the Beni Zilal can step out from the depths of the desert into the open and unveil their grand design.
